gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-fs-recia: Relaxed and inviting, Bpmf Iansui writes like toothpaste squeezed in one line. Recia takes over below with sharp, authoritative letters, its light stroke modulation visible only up close, pleasant for a paragraph or two at a stretch.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-fs-synonym: Synonym lays down a plain stripe of constant ink, with generous openings in every curve, beneath the hand-drawn Bpmf Iansui. Clean, dependable clarity wins out, made for quick reading.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-space-grotesk: A hand-drawn stroke, like toothpaste squeezed in one steady line, gives Bpmf Iansui its relaxed, inviting look. Space Grotesk then adds geometric, neutral lettering with counters that breathe, made for brief reading.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-epunda-slab: Distinctive and expressive, Bruno Ace draws a ruler-straight, constant-width line, while Epunda Slab keeps a visibly gaping c at any size. Low heading letters meet tall, rounded lowercase, giving the page two clear voices.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-kadwa: Kadwa, with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height, takes the classic serif role right beneath Bruno Ace. That ruler-drawn heading line gives the taller body letters a firm frame.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-scope-one: Scope One is traditional and refined, its counters spilling into surrounding space beside stubby ascenders and a big x-height. And Bruno Ace shows off with a traceable constant-width outline, leaving the steady reading work to the body.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-slabo-13px: Counters that stay connected to the outside give Bruno Ace its distinctive, ruler-drawn look. Slabo 13px then reads in bookish, dignified fashion, its large open counters carrying the text across a full page.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-suwannaphum: No stroke contrast slows the eye in Bruno Ace. Suwannaphum brings a paperclip-open c and a high, woodblock-like x-height, and that gap in lowercase height is the pair's real draw.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-epunda-slab: Letters spread like beads on a long thread: that is Bruno Ace SC. Epunda Slab, classic and dignified, grounds it with a visibly gaping c and tall rounded lowercase, and that low-versus-high contrast is the draw.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-fauna-one: Beads on a thread: Bruno Ace SC keeps every stroke open and unthinned. Fauna One, literary and dignified, adds a tall middle band and a generous entry into the e's eye, which is the best part.
